Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed and swapped the directors’ death dates during synthesis—assigning Joseph H. Lewis’s 2000 death date to Marshall Neilan and Neilan’s 1958 death date to Lewis—contradicting the previously gathered sources. This misassociation led to the incorrect conclusion that “His Last Haul” has the director who died later, when the correct answer is “The Falcon in San Francisco.”
